text: あんなに　よく　たべて　よく　ねる　ポケモンは　ほかに　いないよ！

structure.jp: あんなに　よく　たべて　よく　ねる
structure.en: that eats that much and sleeps that much

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あんなに　よく　たべて　よく　ねる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing tells you which thing it is. あんなに　よく　たべて　よく　ねる　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon that eats and sleeps that much'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: たべて　よく　ねる
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. たべて　よく　ねる = 'eats and sleeps a lot'.

patterns.name: ほかに〜ない
patterns.explanation: ほかに with a 'not' verb means there is nothing else besides this one. ほかに　いない = 'there is no other'.
